issues.what: A wide, gray-brown pool replaces much of the broken pale rock pavement, and the coolest water disappears into a muddy gray foreground. The target has a discrete blue-green channel bending through numerous exposed, partly submerged shelves.
issues.fix: Restore exposed, low, irregular shelves through the left flats and shape a connected, blue-green foreground channel between them.

issues.what: The chasm opens farther left and takes up more of the frame. Straight vertical fluting and neat ledges make it read as a stepped quarry instead of an irregular, partly overhung hollow.
issues.fix: Pull the near rim and opening to the right, break the regular terraces, and restore bulky, pale curved overhangs and lodged slabs.

issues.what: The center animal has a nearly vertical neck that reaches the top edge instead of a low forward arch. The left animal is fully inset rather than cropped, and the right one dips toward exposed bank rather than feeding in the water. All three have compact brush ends rather than splayed tendrils.
issues.fix: Lower and curve the center neck forward, bring the left animal closer and partly out of frame, set the right animal in the shallows, and separate and spread the tendrils.

issues.where: water from the left foreground through center-right
issues.what: A broad near-white glare on the left gives way to dark, placid gray water. The target has warm, broken reflections across the shallows and visibly active drips, splashes, and overlapping wavelets under the animals.
issues.fix: Break up the left glare, carry warm reflected glints through the middle and right, and add falling droplets, splash crowns, intersecting ripples and water-distorted reflections at the points of contact.

issues.where: foreground bank beneath and left of the fallen animal
issues.what: A dry-looking, continuous, finely patterned slab replaces the rough, wet, contoured rock and gravel. Its straight edge makes a prominent diagonal boundary with the bright shelf at left.
issues.fix: Break up the slab with irregular relief, gravel, cracks, shallow wet patches and warm wet glints, and blend the boundary into the adjoining terrain.

issues.where: right-hand pit wall and air above it
issues.what: The pit is a straight, terraced vertical cut rather than an angled wall with thick, pale, rounded layers projecting over shadowed recesses. Its broad gray veil hangs across the middle instead of rising in localized billows from below.
issues.fix: Restore the curving pale ledges, deep undercuts and diagonal block, and keep denser layered vapor low in the pit with wisps lifting selectively across the rock.

issues.what: Several left waders are larger, brighter and more isolated than the target's mostly small, dim silhouettes spread through the flats. The near upright and fallen figures are moved toward center-left, closer to the camera.
issues.fix: Spread smaller and more haze-muted animals through the shelves; put the rim pair farther right and deeper in frame, and give the standing animal a more splayed tuft.

issues.where: growth along the near and far chasm rims
issues.what: The main red bush is an isolated compact mound farther left, and smaller growth is sparse on the far rim. The target's growth forms several open, trailing clusters following the rim.
issues.fix: Move the large cluster back along the rim, open and elongate its branches, and repopulate both edges with scattered lower shoots.

issues.what: The upper-left glow is more uniformly peach, the cliff is sharper and more heavily white-streaked, and a broad horizontal fog blanket replaces the small distinct vents across the flats.
issues.fix: Give the light a more localized warm source, soften cliff contrast and whitening toward the distance, and let the plain show through the haze between localized vents.

issues.where: left-middle distance, right bank and upper-left sky
issues.what: The low collapsed form behind the main animals is missing, the right shoreline is flatter and more sparsely vegetated, and diffuse haze replaces the distinct sunlit plume and separate low wisps.
issues.fix: Put a low collapsed silhouette back in the left-middle water, restore rounded wet boulders and spreading red growth on the right, and separate the bright upright plume and smaller low vents from the general haze.

issues.where: main animals' bodies and lower legs
issues.what: The continuous bright outlines and narrow, largely uniform legs read differently from the target's patchier light, wrinkled flesh, joint and foot definition, and dark wet lower legs.
issues.fix: Vary the warm edge lighting, preserve more diffuse light on the bodies, and restore irregular skin, articulated feet and darker wet texture down the shins.

issues.where: bottom foreground and depth of field across the shot
issues.what: Large soft boulders fill a high strip across the bottom, and the right bank and animals soften sooner than in the target, losing the visible wet shelf between the viewer and the subjects.
issues.fix: Lower the foreground occlusion, restore shallow wet edges and isolated bokeh highlights, and hold more detail in static shoreline and the right subject.

issues.where: fallen animal across the lower half
issues.what: The thin, opened torso with exposed ribs and long coarse strands reads more skeletal than the target's fuller collapsed body with opaque folded skin and a finer tangled fringe. The ground beneath also lacks the localized darker stain and scattered gravel.
issues.fix: Fill out and cover the torso with folded, irregular skin, soften the fringe into finer tangled tendrils, and restore a dark ground-contact patch and uneven gravel.

issues.where: standing animal and its ground shadow
issues.what: The animal is higher and farther left, seen more side-on, with a narrow blunt head fringe and nearly bare lower legs. The ground shadow is hard to separate from dark slab bands.
issues.fix: Set the animal lower and slightly right, turn its hindquarters toward camera, spread the hanging red tendrils, and give the feet clear contact and a soft elongated down-right shadow.

issues.what: Dark red brush is massed into a few opaque clumps well behind the standing animal, leaving the near shelves bare. The target has arching, finer red branches wrapping the rim and small clumps in the immediate foreground.
issues.fix: Carry branching growth toward camera across the left ledges and behind the live animal, add sparse near shoots, and catch warm pinpoints on individual tendrils.

issues.where: upper-left light, distant flats and far escarpment
issues.what: A broad flat peach glow and horizontal mist mute the discrete backlit steam and the patchy gold sparkle on the flats. The left background herd looks sparse and atypically upright, and the static cave backdrop is less defined and shifted toward the right edge.
issues.fix: Restore a brighter localized low-sun glow, a distinct buoyant plume and broken gold glints; add dispersed bent feeding figures, and hold more definition and room around the far cave.
